tools.name: dota_hero_lookup
tools.description: FREE Dota 2 hero lookup: base stats, gains, attack. Base attributes and gains, health, mana, armor, attack damage, BAT, range, move speed and roles for a hero (name or alias like "am"). Always free. (free, no payment)

tools.name: dota_item_lookup
tools.description: FREE Dota 2 item lookup: cost, stats, components. Gold cost, stat bonuses and components of an item. Always free. (free, no payment)
